name: reference-art-loop
title_zh: 名画笔法拆成可执行代码，按原作工序重画
tagline_zh: 不是滤镜，不是风格迁移。它拆解《千里江山图》的笔法工序，用 p5.js/Canvas 重画你的主题。
tagline_en: Not a filter, not style transfer. It extracts the brushwork sequence from a reference like *A Thousand Li of.
desc_en: ALIGN — Agentic Loop Image GeneratioN. Paint a subject in the craft of a reference artwork as executable p5.js, Canvas, SVG or another mark-based medium, replay that craft's real order of work, and improve it through pixel-only cross-model review. The reference fixes the craft; the subject may be the reference's own scene (千里江山图 → p5.js) or another (清明上河图 → 武汉). Not for one-shot raster image gener
why_zh: 把「画风」还原为可复盘的工序序列，而非模糊的视觉相似；跨模型像素级评审让迭代有客观标尺，而非自说自话。
why_en: Reduces 'style' to a replayable sequence of mark-making steps, not fuzzy visual similarity; cross-model pixel review gives.
limit_zh: 只输出可执行代码（p5.js/Canvas/SVG 等），不生成位图成品；需要目标环境能运行这些代码。
limit_en: Outputs executable code only (p5.js/Canvas/SVG), no raster final image; target environment must run that code. Reference must have parseable.
title_en: Executable brushwork: replay a masterpiece's craft in code
